reason: A client-side CSS plugin that adapts the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for narrow mobile screens by rearranging panels, controls, menus, and popups without modifying product source.

summaries.zh: 通过客户端 CSS 覆盖优化 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 在窄屏移动设备上的面板、控件、菜单和弹窗布局。
summaries.en: A client-side CSS overlay that improves DeepSeek Harness Web UI layouts for narrow mobile screens, including panels, controls, menus, and popups.

capabilities: Injects a client-side CSS style overlay for narrow web layouts
Adjusts web UI panels, menus, popups, and controls for mobile viewport widths
Removes the injected style on unload
